description: One ETFIQ benchmark in full: its rule as the methodology states it, the funds and weights in force (with SEC series ids and each fund's expense ratio and its date), and every statistic ETFIQ computes for it by window (total return, return a year, volatility, maximum drawdown, Sharpe ratio, turnover, factor loadings, weighted expense ratio), each with its dates and its basis. ALWAYS read basis: a figure from before the freeze date is hypothetical. Takes an id such as etfiq-strategic-60 or strategic-60. Serves the published benchmark only; it cannot be customised.
name: get_benchmark
